description: Architected an **FSM-based biometric engine** replacing unstable React hooks with deterministic state transitions for **99.9% reliability** during AI analysis. Optimized **AI pipelines** to support **60 FPS** pose estimation and real-time rep counting via adaptive frame rate logic. Led a full rewrite of the **medical assessment chatbot** with Redux Toolkit and refactored **54+ modules** into Presentational/Container pattern.

Boosted application performance by **40%** by stripping legacy UI libraries and optimizing React rendering cycles. Achieved **70% infrastructure cost reduction** by migrating Azure VMs to App Service and automating CI/CD pipelines. Deployed a **HIPAA-compliant SSO system** with multi-role access, OAuth integration, and strict CSP headers.

Reduced patient diagnosis time by **25%** and achieved **95% accuracy** by integrating **real-time AI analysis** and custom algorithms. Integrated a **WebRTC video pipeline** stabilizing remote consultations and reducing call latency. Developed a **JWT-based REST API client layer** with built-in XSS and CSRF protection.

Built and maintained **UI components** for a telemedicine platform using React.js, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3, improving user experience across devices. Debugged and optimized front-end code, **reducing page load time** and enhancing performance stability.

Maintained **IT operations and systems reliability** through software updates and hardware maintenance, **minimizing disruptions** to teaching and learning. Tracked program and **student-progress data** to support assessments, feedback, and organizational reporting. Supported curriculum delivery and ensured a stable, productive learning environment.

Designed and delivered a **student-centered computer-skills curriculum** covering IT fundamentals, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint, aligned with industry standards. Improved student proficiency and confidence through **hands-on instruction**, **fair assessment**, and progress tracking.

Developed and maintained **web applications with PHP and JavaScript**. Analyzed **client needs** and developed appropriate functionality. Created and executed **test scenarios** to ensure quality deliverables.

summary: Built the shared API foundation for an MCQ learning platform, including module structure, middleware, and deployment configuration. Exam execution and result persistence remained outside the completed scope.
description: Built the **backend foundation for an MCQ learning platform**, organizing questions, exams, courses, enrolment, and results into separate Express modules behind a versioned API. Centralized controller wrappers, response formatting, and error handling so new learning features could follow a shared implementation pattern. Configured request limits, timeouts, and security middleware at the application boundary, alongside administrator email notifications and Docker/PM2 deployment configuration. This established shared API infrastructure; exam execution and result persistence remained outside the completed scope.

summary: Developed school administration, admission-document, and survey workflows across web interfaces and backend services. Co-developed a PHP catalog and administration project; the linked case studies distinguish prototypes from completed features.
description: Translated **school administration and research workflows into structured web interfaces and backend services**. Implemented admission-document handling that uploads files to Google Drive and stores their identifiers and links in MongoDB, linking documents to school records. Separated controllers, persistence services, and Joi validation to keep input rules and database operations explicit. Modeled survey definitions, reusable templates, and completed school/location records separately to distinguish research setup from collected responses. Built reusable Next.js pages for admissions, notices, routines, and results, and co-developed database-backed PHP catalog and administration interfaces.

summary: Built React inventory interfaces and Express/MongoDB resource APIs covering stock, deliveries, and supporting business records. The interfaces depend on a separate backend; the case studies document the verified implementation scope.
description: Implemented **inventory workflows spanning account access, item browsing, stock updates, and delivery actions** in React. Integrated Firebase sign-in, shared authentication and token-request helpers, and stock-update API calls alongside user-specific item views. In a separate Express backend, implemented MongoDB product reads, creates, updates, and deletes, with distinct routes for pharmacy and non-pharmacy inventory. Organized orders, returns, suppliers, customers, and employees into dedicated resource endpoints, to separate the records supporting inventory operations.
